channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump announces Russian diesel deal amid soaring US fuel prices
item.description: Russia to supply 300,000 tonnes of diesel immediately, followed by 1.5 million more, as prices soar amid the Iran war.

item.title: Drone strike kills 30 people in Sudan’s Blue Nile region
item.description: Drone reportedly linked to RSF targets Wad al-Mahi, killing dozens near displacement camp, including women and children.

item.title: Three Saudi nationals killed in Houthi attacks on Riyadh airport
item.description: The missile attacks come amid an escalation in fighting between the Iran-backed group and Saudi Arabia, which backs Yemen's government.
